While the story is well-written and uses subtle, understated details to depict the quiet distance between a grieving mother and her adult son, it relies on very familiar literary tropes (such as a white-collar child returning to a stoic, blue-collar parent's home after the death of the other parent). It captures a relatable emotional moment, but it is too brief and conventional in its subject matter to offer a truly unique or original idea, perspective, or insight that an average reader wouldn't have encountered many times before.
